selected.rationale: Loss on the compose-post->post-storage edge removes the primary persistence step; without a timeout or retry, the entire post creation call hangs or fails, breaking the core write path.
Unique ID generation is the first mandatory synchronous call in compose-post; loss here stalls all post creation before any work is done, exposing missing fallback and timeout defenses.

Home-timeline fanout is a critical write-path dependency; loss blocks or silently drops follower timeline updates and can fail the whole compose-post request if the call is synchronous without a timeout.
User-timeline update is a required write-path dependency; loss on this edge breaks the author's own timeline and can fail the entire compose request, showing no retry or degradation.
Text storage is essential for every post; loss on compose-post->text causes the content write to fail or hang, revealing missing retry/fallback for the core post content.
Home-timeline->post-storage is the read path for timelines; loss makes timeline rendering fail or hang, exposing the absence of read-side timeout and retry defenses.
Media processing is a potentially slow dependency; delay propagates unboundedly into compose-post if no timeout is present, hanging all posts that include media.
Killing social-graph takes out a core home-timeline dependency; availability loss on the read path is not mitigated and recovery depends on pod restart, exposing missing failover.
